Name: Leah and Elliott Character Sprites for Yuti Portraits

Description:
Hello! I’m uploading this here upon request.Please note that I used a translator, so some expressions may sound a bit awkward.This retexture is a character sprite based on 유티’s portraits, which is distributed in the Korean Stardew Valley community on Naver.Therefore, I recommend using it together with 유티’s portraits for the best match!Since there are several versions available, please choose your favorite outfit, and make sure to rename the files correctly before applying them.Both PNG and XNB files are provided, so you can use whichever format you prefer.유티’s original portraits, another creator’s beach portraits (v1.6), and the winter portraits that I edited based on 유티’s art (distributed only on Naver)can be downloaded separately from the links I’ll provide below.Thank you!
